<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="4">
    <description>
                              The Brusselator is a theoretical model for a type of autocatalytic chemical reaction.<br>
<a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brusselator">http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brusselator</a><br>
















Initially the system oscillates. After around 50000 timesteps the world becomes dominated by rotating spirals. 
This behavior is seen with real chemicals in the Belousov–Zhabotinsky reaction.<br>
<a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belousov%E2%80%93Zhabotinsky_reaction">http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belousov-Zhabotinsky_reaction</a>
















Thanks to Jan Krieger for the code:<br>
<a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Brusselator_space.gif">http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Brusselator_space.gif</a>
    </description>
    <rule name="Brusselator" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.0291
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.2
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.005
      </param>
      <param name="k1">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="k2">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="k3">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="k4">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="A">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="B">
        3
      </param>
      <param name="dps">
        0.014
      </param>
      <param name="vs">
        0.92
      </param>
      <param name="D_c">
        0.2
      </param>
      <param name="rs">
        0.5
      </param>
      <param name="D_u">
        0.9
      </param>
      <param name="D_ub">
        0.125
      </param>
      <param name="sk">
        1
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="6">
        const float4 _G0 = 0.25f; // center weight
const float _G1 = 0.125f; // edge-neighbors
const float _G2 = 0.0625f; // vertex-neighbors
float4 gaussian_c = (float4)(c_n.x*_G1 + c_n.y*_G2 + c.y*_G1 + c_s.y*_G2 + c_s.x*_G1 + c_sw.w*_G2 + c_w.w*_G1 + c_nw.w*_G2,
c_n.y*_G1 + c_n.z*_G2 + c.z*_G1 + c_s.z*_G2 + c_s.y*_G1 + c_s.x*_G2 + c.x*_G1 + c_n.x*_G2,
c_n.z*_G1 + c_n.w*_G2 + c.w*_G1 + c_s.w*_G2 + c_s.z*_G1 + c_s.y*_G2 + c.y*_G1 + c_n.y*_G2,
c_n.w*_G1 + c_ne.x*_G2 + c_e.x*_G1 + c_se.x*_G2 + c_s.w*_G1 + c_s.z*_G2 + c.z*_G1 + c_n.z*_G2 ) + c*_G0;
float4 gaussian_d = (float4)(d_n.x*_G1 + d_n.y*_G2 + d.y*_G1 + d_s.y*_G2 + d_s.x*_G1 + d_sw.w*_G2 + d_w.w*_G1 + d_nw.w*_G2,
d_n.y*_G1 + d_n.z*_G2 + d.z*_G1 + d_s.z*_G2 + d_s.y*_G1 + d_s.x*_G2 + d.x*_G1 + d_n.x*_G2,
d_n.z*_G1 + d_n.w*_G2 + d.w*_G1 + d_s.w*_G2 + d_s.z*_G1 + d_s.y*_G2 + d.y*_G1 + d_n.y*_G2,
d_n.w*_G1 + d_ne.x*_G2 + d_e.x*_G1 + d_se.x*_G2 + d_s.w*_G1 + d_s.z*_G2 + d.z*_G1 + d_n.z*_G2 ) + d*_G0;
float4 gaussian_e = (float4)(e_n.x*_G1 + e_n.y*_G2 + e.y*_G1 + e_s.y*_G2 + e_s.x*_G1 + e_sw.w*_G2 + e_w.w*_G1 + e_nw.w*_G2,
e_n.y*_G1 + e_n.z*_G2 + e.z*_G1 + e_s.z*_G2 + e_s.y*_G1 + e_s.x*_G2 + e.x*_G1 + e_n.x*_G2,
e_n.z*_G1 + e_n.w*_G2 + e.w*_G1 + e_s.w*_G2 + e_s.z*_G1 + e_s.y*_G2 + e.y*_G1 + e_n.y*_G2,
e_n.w*_G1 + e_ne.x*_G2 + e_e.x*_G1 + e_se.x*_G2 + e_s.w*_G1 + e_s.z*_G2 + e.z*_G1 + e_n.z*_G2 ) + e*_G0;
float4 uax = (float4)(
(-(a_nw.w + a_sw.w) + (a_n.y   + a_s.y) - 2.0 * a_w.w + 2.0 * a.y  ),
(-(a_n.x  + a_s.x)  + (a_n.z   + a_s.z) - 2.0 * a.x   + 2.0 * a.z  ),
(-(a_n.y  + a_s.y)  + (a_n.w   + a_s.w) - 2.0 * a.y   + 2.0 * a.w  ),
(-(a_n.z  + a_s.z)  + (a_ne.x + a_se.x) - 2.0 * a.z   + 2.0 * a_e.x));
float4 uay = (float4)(
((a_nw.w + a_n.y ) - (a_sw.w +  a_s.y) - 2.0 * a_s.x + 2.0 * a_n.x),
((a_n.x  + a_n.z ) - (a_s.x  +  a_s.z) - 2.0 * a_s.y + 2.0 * a_n.y),
((a_n.y  + a_n.w ) - (a_s.y  +  a_s.w) - 2.0 * a_s.z + 2.0 * a_n.z),
((a_n.z  + a_ne.x) - (a_s.z  + a_se.x) - 2.0 * a_s.w + 2.0 * a_n.w));
float4 ubx = (float4)(
(-(b_nw.w + b_sw.w) + (b_n.y   + b_s.y) - 2.0 * b_w.w + 2.0 * b.y  ),
(-(b_n.x  + b_s.x)  + (b_n.z   + b_s.z) - 2.0 * b.x   + 2.0 * b.z  ),
(-(b_n.y  + b_s.y)  + (b_n.w   + b_s.w) - 2.0 * b.y   + 2.0 * b.w  ),
(-(b_n.z  + b_s.z)  + (b_ne.x + b_se.x) - 2.0 * b.z   + 2.0 * b_e.x));
float4 uby = (float4)(
((b_nw.w + b_n.y ) - (b_sw.w +  b_s.y) - 2.0 * b_s.x + 2.0 * b_n.x),
((b_n.x  + b_n.z ) - (b_s.x  +  b_s.z) - 2.0 * b_s.y + 2.0 * b_n.y),
((b_n.y  + b_n.w ) - (b_s.y  +  b_s.w) - 2.0 * b_s.z + 2.0 * b_n.z),
((b_n.z  + b_ne.x) - (b_s.z  + b_se.x) - 2.0 * b_s.w + 2.0 * b_n.w));
delta_a = sk * f + D_a * laplacian_a + k1*A + k2*a*a*b - k3*B*a - k4*a;
delta_b = D_b * laplacian_b        - k2*a*a*b + k3*B*a;
c = uax * uax;
d = uax * uay;
e = uay * uay;

float4 lambda1 = 0.5f * (-sqrt(gaussian_c*gaussian_c - 2.0f*gaussian_c*gaussian_e + 4.0f*gaussian_d*gaussian_d + gaussian_e*gaussian_e) + gaussian_c + gaussian_e);
float4 lambda2 = 0.5f * ( sqrt(gaussian_c*gaussian_c - 2.0f*gaussian_c*gaussian_e + 4.0f*gaussian_d*gaussian_d + gaussian_e*gaussian_e) + gaussian_c + gaussian_e);

// clamp sanitizes NaN
f = 1.0f - pow(clamp((lambda1 - lambda2)/(lambda1 + lambda2), -1.0f, 1.0f), 2.0f);
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
